Cascade Carpenters and Laborers Effective June 1, 2026
Local 000 · Wage and fringe schedule, commercial work Page 1 of 1
CLASSIFICATION HOURLY RATE FRINGE PER HOUR
Overtime: 1.5 times the straight-time rate for hours over 40 in a workweek.
Fringe: $2.30 per hour worked, straight time and overtime, paid to the Cascade Carpenters and Laborers Trust.
Working dues: 2.25% of gross wages, withheld each pay period and remitted with the fringe.
Contributions and dues are reported and remitted monthly, by the 15th of the following month.
